scientific_integrity: Analytic proof for all real s>=0, with eighteen exact-rational spot checks; no claim of computational exhaustive real-parameter coverage or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact profile applies only to the S4-symmetric one-parameter central hyperplane sections of [-1,1]^5. The general dimension-four ridge-skeleton conjecture remains open. Its s=0 endpoint is already implied by the primary reference; older skeletal integral-geometry literature was not fully accessible.
title: Exact ridge-area profile for symmetric four-dimensional sections of the five-cube
